theorem_title: The reciprocal-triple-free maximum increases by one from 733 to 734
natural_language_statement:
Call a subset of positive integers admissible if it contains no $a<b<c$ satisfying $a(b+c)=bc$, equivalently $1/a=1/b+1/c$. Let $k\in\mathbb N$. If $k$ is an attained maximum cardinality for admissible subsets of $\{1,\ldots,733\}$, then

$$
\max\{|S|:S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,734\},\ S\text{ admissible}\}=k+1.
$$

This exact finite transfer is independent of any specified numerical baseline at 731 or733. The maximum includes both an attaining witness and a universal upper bound.
